scope_note: The sources establish classical affine-subspace arrangement counting context. The C042 theorem is the elementary laminar specialization with an executable proof package; it does not solve general subspace-union complement finding or P versus NP.

sources.title: Subspace Arrangements over Finite Fields: Cohomological and Enumerative Properties
sources.role: Primary context for counting points on and off unions of linear or affine subspaces over finite fields through arrangement combinatorics.

sources.title: Affine Dispersers from Subspace Polynomials
sources.role: Primary complexity-theoretic context for affine sources and explicit operations on affine subspaces over GF(2); not used as a hidden solver.
Internal predecessor proving that coordinate substitution alone preserves arbitrary 3-CNF on the C023 hard image, so C042 must require an independently verified tractable arrangement certificate.
